declarations.description:
A text-only, variable-height virtual log viewport. Filters are controlled by the application; find is the viewer's own.

The viewport is one Tab stop holding an active entry. With it focused, Arrow Up/Down move the active entry (a tall
entry scrolls line by line until its end is in view), Page Up/Down move it by a viewport, Home jumps to the first
entry and End to the last, resuming following the tail (Ctrl/Command variants also work), and Enter fires
`entry-activate`. Clicking an entry makes it active.

Ctrl/Command+F inside the viewer opens the find bar: it searches every displayed entry, not only the rendered ones,
marks the matches and moves the active entry to the current one. Enter and Shift+Enter (or F3, Ctrl/Command+G) step
through the matches, Alt+C toggles match case, Escape closes the bar; Ctrl/Command+F pressed again in the bar is left
to the browser. Set `find-shortcut="false"` to leave Ctrl/Command+F to the page; `find()` still opens the bar.

members.name: tabular
members.description: Align attributes vertically in columns; false displays concatenated entry text.

members.name: wrap
members.description: Break text to fit the available column or viewport width.

members.name: columns
members.description: Ordered attribute names. Empty discovers attributes automatically, with message last.

members.name: findShortcut
members.description: Open the find bar on Ctrl/Command+F while focus is inside the viewer. `false` leaves the shortcut to the page.

members.name: lineWidths
members.default: new WeakMap<LogEntry, { text: string; widths: number[] }>()

members.name: active
members.description: Source index of the active entry, or -1.

members.name: findCounts
members.description: Matches per layout position, and the running total before each position (built on demand).

members.name: entryCount
members.description: Number of retained entries, including entries hidden by the current filter.

members.name: filteredCount
members.description: Number of entries matching the current filter.

members.name: activeIndex
members.description:
Index of the active entry among the retained entries (as in `entry-click`), or -1. Setting it to a displayed
entry makes that entry active and scrolls it into view; any other value clears it.

members.name: findMatchCount
members.description: Number of find matches across the displayed entries; 0 while find is closed.

members.name: findMatchIndex
members.description: Position of the current find match among `findMatchCount`, or -1.

members.name: find
members.description: Open the find bar with `query` (an empty string clears it) and move to the first match from the active entry or the top of the view.

members.name: findNext
members.description: Move to the next find match, wrapping after the last. Returns false when there is none.

members.name: findPrevious
members.description: Move to the previous find match, wrapping before the first. Returns false when there is none.

members.name: closeFind
members.description: Close the find bar and remove its marks. The query is kept for the next time it opens.

members.name: appendEntries
members.description: Append an atomic snapshot of one entry or a batch. Existing data is retained while filtered.

members.name: setFilter
members.description: Replace criteria; filter hides nonmatches, highlight marks matches while keeping every entry visible. null clears criteria.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clear retained entries; the current filter remains active.

members.name: scrollToStart
members.description: Scroll to the first matching entry and hold it there through appends until the user scrolls or `scrollToEnd()` is called.

members.name: scrollToEnd
members.description: Scroll to the newest matching content and resume following subsequent appends.

members.name: widthsFor
members.description: Natural widths of an entry's primary text lines, kept while the font and the text stay the same.

members.name: countFind
members.description: Recount matches from a layout position on: every position after a rebuild, only the appended ones otherwise.

members.name: positionAfter
members.description: The first layout position whose source is at or after `source`.

members.name: firstMatchFrom
members.description: The first match at or after a layout position, wrapping to the top; null when nothing matches.

members.name: selectMatch
members.description: Make the match at a position among all matches current: it becomes the active entry and is scrolled into view.

members.name: runFind
members.description: Re-run find for a new query or case setting.

members.name: selectFirstMatch
members.description: Count every match and make the first one at or after the active entry (else the top of the view) current.

members.name: selectedText
members.description: Text selected inside the viewer, when it is one line: what Ctrl/Command+F looks for.

members.name: rulerTicks
members.description: Ruler tick offsets as fractions of the content height, one per RULER_STEP pixels of viewport.

members.name: layoutPosition
members.description: Layout entries are ordered by source, so the anchor is found by binary search instead of a scan.

members.name: onFindStepKey
members.description: F3 and Ctrl/Command+G step through the matches, Shift going back; with the bar closed they reopen it on the last query.

members.name: revealEntry
members.description: Scroll just enough to show an entry; one taller than the view shows its top, or its end when reached from below.

members.name: revealMatch
members.description: Bring a find match into view: its visual line vertically (centred when it was off screen), its text horizontally.

members.name: renderAttribute
members.description: An attribute cell's lines as they are: no token colours, only find marks.

members.name: entryMarks
members.description: Find marks of a rendered entry, one list per cell; matching runs only for entries in the virtual window.

events.name: entry-activate
events.description: Fired when Enter is pressed on the active entry, with the same detail as `entry-click`. Bubbles.

events.name: entry-click
events.description: Fired when an entry is clicked, except on its copy button or at the end of a drag or text selection. Bubbles.
